name: How long does kitchen wall tile installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does kitchen wall tile installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of kitchen wall tile installation depends on the project's scope, including the total area to be tiled, the type of tile, and any necessary surface preparation. A small backsplash can often be completed in 1-2 days, while a larger area with custom patterns might take 3-5 days or more. This timeframe includes preparation, tiling, grouting, and sealing. We will provide a specific timeline after assessing your project.
